args.body: Hi Dora — I visited your personal website. It’s a nice, straightforward starting point, and the personal focus makes it feel approachable. To make it even more useful to visitors, consider adding a brief introduction or headline explaining what you do, a few highlighted projects or accomplishments, and clear links for contacting you or learning more. A little more visual structure and detail would help the site tell your story.

Hi Eve — I visited your blog. The personal touch comes through, and your interest in hiking gives the site a clear opportunity for a distinctive theme. You could make it even stronger with a short author/about section, prominent categories or recent-post navigation, and a featured hiking post or photo to give visitors an immediate sense of the blog’s focus. Clear dates and an easy way to browse older posts would also improve the reading experience.
